data.long_meaning: Maryamah is the feminine form of Maryam, meaning 'blessed' or 'pious'. It is a revered name in Islamic tradition, associated with Mary, the mother of Jesus. The name Maryamah carries the meaning “Blessed, Pious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maryamah usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed, pious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
